raw: A notice under subsection (1) must be served in accordance with Part 8.3 of Chapter 8 of the Criminal Procedure Act 2009.

new: the transcript of the evidence in the trial;
raw: After section 223(1)(h) of the Criminal Procedure Act 2009 insert— "(ha) the transcript of the evidence in the trial;".
After section 223(1)(k) of the Criminal Procedure Act 2009 insert— "(ka) a jury guide;".

new: A jury guide referred to in subsection (1)(ka) may contain any of the following— (a) a list of questions to assist the jury in reaching a verdict (including questions that are included in integrated directions within the meaning of section 19 of the Jury Directions Act 2013); (b) directions on the evidence and how the evidence is to be assessed; (c) references to the way in which the prosecution and the accused have put their cases in relation to the issues in the trial; (d) any evidence identified under section 18 of the Jury Directions Act 2013; (e) any other information.
raw: After section 223(1) of the Criminal Procedure Act 2009 insert— "(1A) A jury guide referred to in subsection (1)(ka) may contain any of the following— (a) a list of questions to assist the jury in reaching a verdict (including questions that are included in integrated directions within the meaning of section 19 of the Jury Directions Act 2013); (b) directions on the evidence and how the evidence is to be assessed; (c) references to the way in which the prosecution and the accused have put their cases in relation to the issues in the trial; (d) any evidence identified under section 18 of the Jury Directions Act 2013; (e) any other information.".
At the foot of section 238 of the Criminal Procedure Act 2009 insert—
after "under" (where secondly occurring) insert "the Jury Directions Act 2013 or"

new: Transitional provision—Jury Directions Act 2013 Section 223 as amended by the Jury Directions Act 2013 applies to a trial that commences on or after the day on which that Act comes into operation.
raw: After section 442 of the Criminal Procedure Act 2009 insert— "443 Transitional provision—Jury Directions Act 2013 Section 223 as amended by the Jury Directions Act 2013 applies to a trial that commences on or after the day on which that Act comes into operation.".
